events.title: Proposed ruling: escalate (model confidence 0.55)
events.body: The trip is RydeTAXI, metered, so a route deviation would flow into the fare: the record shows actual 10.2 km vs 7.2 km optimal (+3.0 km) and one measured off-route segment 09:04–09:14 adding 4.15 km [F2][F4], with $7.04 of excess distance billed at $1.4100/km [F5][F7]. Under RD-2 the refund is only the sum of unexempt segment extra_km × the trip's per-km rate, so the case turns on which segments are unexempt [RD-2].

ruling.recommended_action: Send to a Ryde reviewer: pull the full GPS trace (or meter/route records) for 09:14–09:20:45, confirm the meter and fare breakdown against the taxi company's meter, and only then assess the excess distance under RD-2. No account action at this stage.
ruling.reasoning: The trip is RydeTAXI, metered, so a route deviation would flow into the fare: the record shows actual 10.2 km vs 7.2 km optimal (+3.0 km) and one measured off-route segment 09:04–09:14 adding 4.15 km [F2][F4], with $7.04 of excess distance billed at $1.4100/km [F5][F7]. Under RD-2 the refund is only the sum of unexempt segment extra_km × the trip's per-km rate, so the case turns on which segments are unexempt [RD-2].

segment_findings.reason: The complete, fully timestamped chat contains no rider message agreeing to any route change before the off-route segment started at 09:04 [F10][F8][F9]; the driver's post-trip assertion that the GPS rerouted and that he merely followed it is a statement, not rider consent, and RD-5 requires the rider's own message sent before the segment begins [F11][RD-5]. No discussion of the reroute appears anywhere in the chat, so there is no consent to read and the segment cannot be marked exempt [RD-5]; equally, the driver's account puts the driven path on a rerouted corridor rather than at a named rider-approved place, so no exemption ground is established and no non-exempt refund can yet be quantified.

ruling.evidence_gap: GPS trace ends 4 min 0 s before the 09:20:45 drop-off, so the last stretch of the trip (09:14–09:20:45) is unmeasured; without it the total excess distance and any further off-route segment cannot be attributed, and the RD-2 computation cannot be completed [F1][F2][F5].
ruling.escalation_reason: Evidence insufficiency flagged by the trace (uncovered final stretch) requires a human to complete the record before any refund is computed under RD-2; no safety concern found, so the escalation is evidentiary only.
